name: KAPEX
summary: Korea's national 'physical AI' humanoid, developed by the Korea Institute of Science and Technology with LG and shown publicly in November 2025. Korea pitches it as a third pole against US and Chinese humanoids, with a push to use domestic components. Published height and mass vary between reports (about 160–175 cm, 55–65 kg).

sources.title: South Korea Challenges US and China with 'KAPEX' Humanoid Robot — Humanoids Daily
KIST KAPEX — domestic components with LG — Humanoids Daily
